summary: Store Map push intent per definition so fusion, partial reconstruction, expression rewrites and copies preserve only the intended movement eligibility.
review: No global OR of map flags: unmarked lower definitions remain unmarked after fusion.
Through-input pushdown checks each definition; kept and pushed maps retain the flags through value copying.
Logical copy copies per-definition values before rebinding; SetMapElementExpression preserves the flag through rename/type-annotation/replacement.
OLAP projection reconstruction preserves the surviving definition intent.
The existing UT is adjusted only to the explicit marking API; no new exact workload/repro is embedded.
Independent base-relative artifact only; no production checkout edits or builds.
validation_plan: Operator-level checks: marked top over unmarked bottom and reversed flags, all-moved/partially-kept/none-moved cases, logical copies and definition rebinding.
Confirm only marked definitions cross Filter/Join; unmarked erroring expressions retain demand placement.
Run outer-join preservation controls, scalar-cardinality demand controls from C15, and existing global RBO unit suite.
Count surviving/pushed marked definitions and verify native semantics before claiming optimization recovery.
limits: Six files are required because push intent is definition state and the old public map-wide field is used by an existing unit test.
This preserves the existing rule safety/side conditions; it does not authorize a broader class of expression movement.
Q25 and C40 may overlap in the OLAP projection rewrite; integrate flags with the C40 fallback without dropping either fix.
Native semantic verification and compile remain required.
